summary: Align merge authority with the rules and add checks-not-run state

delivery.outcome: Every merge event resolves autonomously through onedev-agent or validator-agent; only the Validator reaches MERGED; a check that never ran is never green.
nonGoals: No change to the protected direct-pr-registry or Validator runtime
No new error code or CQRS operation
No GitHub ruleset or billing change

architecture.decision: Add merge-events.env as a second normative Env DSL document validated by conformance.py; extend merge-rules.env with RULE_CHECKS_NOT_RUN_CONDITION; align docs with RULE_MERGE_EXECUTOR_CONDITION.
architecture.rollback: Revert the merge commit; merge-rules.env and conformance.py return to the previous pinned RULES_DIGEST together.

validation.evidence: eventMatrix: 26 events route once; 3 invariant mutations rejected
parityCases include validator/owner not-run cases in checker and equations
no document grants agent merge or bypass
